newsitem.title: USA: Avondale Industries Q2 helped by spending.
newsitem.headline: Avondale Industries Q2 helped by spending.

text.p: Avondale Industries Inc said Thursday that a favorable trend in pretax earnings reflects the investments it has made in new manufacturing systems to increase productivity and efficiency.
Avondale reported second quarter earnings of $0.44 a share, compared to $0.99 a share the previous second quarter. The year-ago second quarter resutls include a $0.62 tax benefit.
Backlog is currently $3.8 billion, including unexercised options for vessels under multi-ship contracts.

"An important strategic objective has been to build a more balanced base of work between commercial and military contracts," said Albert Bossier, chairman and chief executive officer, in a press release.

"The $332 million contract award during the second quarter for two crude carriers for ARCO Marine is indicative of Avondale 's potential to capitalize on our proven shipbuilding expertise. These tankers will be designed for compliance with the new double-hull standards that have been mandated by the Oil Pollution Act of 1990," he said.
"As the phase-in of this requirement continues, we expect other opportunities for additional contracts to develop."
The company also said that it it believes that 1997 as a whole will mark another year of "noteworthy progress".
